name: Persuasive (Elf)
body:
You speak precisely and persuasively, especially among elves.

Benefit(s) You gain a +1 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks. This bonus increases to +3 against creatures with the elf subtype.

Another Idea…

It seems reasonable to reword this as:

You speak precisely and persuasively, especially among your own kind.

Benefit(s) You gain a +1 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks. This bonus increases to +3 against creatures of your race or subtype.
